Covers the five chained combinations no earlier capture reached (distance->trajectory, distance->aggregate, distance->efficiency, spread->efficiency, spread->rank) plus the `offset` and `bars` parameters, neither of which had ever been exercised. ZERO mispredictions in this batch - the fanout fixes held and this surface was already correct. Read-only; renders without mutating strategy state.
_capturedAtNote: APPROXIMATE to the minute. Taken in the same sweep as _renders_collision.json (17:16:01Z), a few minutes before it; the exact call time was not recorded.
_spreadRankNote: EMA5 is the ONLY metric that can chain spread->rank, and only with operand EMA13 - its rankableSpreadOperands is exactly ['EMA13']. This matches doc 03's claim that the platform pre-computes a ranked universe for that one derived quantity and nothing else.
_barsNote: bars='closed' changed CCI_now from 183.5 (bars='all', _renders.json) to 143.8 here, while every header stayed identical. You cannot tell from a header whether the forming bar is in the series.

section.title: omega chains and params
section.text:
VWAP: volume-weighted average price accumulated since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor. dist_VWAP: % from current price to VWAP. 3-period trajectory (t2 → … → now); dist_VWAP_trend = direction over the window. dist_VWAP_mean3: windowed mean. dist_VWAP_er: efficiency ratio over the last 3 points of a level series, |last − first| ÷ Σ|consecutive change| — 1 is a straight move, near 0 is chop. EMA5: 5-period exponential moving average. EMA5_EMA13_spread: % gap EMA5 vs EMA13. EMA5_EMA13_spread_er: efficiency ratio over the last 3 points of a level series, |last − first| ÷ Σ|consecutive change| — 1 is a straight move, near 0 is chop. EMA5_EMA13_spread_rank_lo: ordinal across the tracked universe, 1 = lowest value, rendered as rank/universe-size; the standing as of the last close, unchanged until the next one. RSI14: 14-period relative strength index (0–100). CCI: 20-period commodity channel index (±100 reference). 3-period trajectory (t2 → … → now); closed bars only (the forming bar is excluded); CCI_trend = direction over the window. atrPct: average true range as a % of price, (ATR / close) × 100 — the cross-coin comparable form of ATR. pctB: where the close sits in the Bollinger envelope, (close − lower) / (upper − lower) — 0 at the lower band, 1 at the upper, outside [0,1] when price trades beyond them.
